svg.title: Claude Code — Multi-Agent Workspace Standards
svg.desc: A dependency map of nine standards blocks. Foundation is a full-width base slab; the Pool Coordination Bus is the glowing core; Pool Lifecycle Tooling (bring up) and Shutdown & Context Hygiene (wind down) form a teal lifecycle pair beside the core; Workspace, Roles and DevOps work over the bus; Skills delivers canon; Remote Bridge is an optional add-on plugged into the bus.
svg.text: A dependency map of the 9 standards blocks (A–I) — what rests on what, and what feeds what.
